chapter: Apollo Bar, Apollo managers and Harlem nightlife
title: Connie's Inn and Jack Leg's Diamond
summary: Whaley recalls Connie's Inn on 132nd Street and begins a story about gambler Jack Diamond.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Everything started after I got in the Apollo Theatre. When I came to New York, the Connie's Inn wasn't there.
The what. Where was that at.
And 7th Avenue. It was near what theatre.

Right near the Lafayette Theatre. It was a college inn I think then and then they -- what was the name of the brothers, George and -- they bought the thing and turned it over -- I used to arrange music in there. Yeah. I've arranged music all over the -- I'll tell you about Jack Leg's Diamonds.
